sloka: विक्रीतमाहितं क्रीतं यत् पित्रा जीवता मम ।न तल्लोपयितुं शक्यं मया वा भरतेन वा ॥ २.१११.२८॥
transliteration: vikrītamāhitaṁ krītaṁ yat pitrā jīvatā mama ।na tallopayituṁ śakyaṁ mayā vā bharatena vā ॥ 2.111.28॥

translations.english: Neither Bharata nor I can in any way annul anything which was sold, pledged or bought by my father during his lifetime.
